verdict.rationale: Generating or editing workflows from a natural-language prompt is a fair question for a workflow orchestration platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows Temporal is Workflows-as-Code, and its AI integrations (Google ADK, Vercel AI SDK) and llms.txt are about orchestrating AI apps or serving docs to LLMs. None of them is a built-in prompt-to-workflow capability, so there is no documented support for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can generate or edit a workflow from a natural-language prompt
